name: Closed-Form Color Field Estimation
definition: A rendering-independent color estimation technique that computes the color field solely from the density field and posed training images in closed form, decoupling shape and radiance to reduce NeRF's shape-radiance ambiguity.
summary: Closed-form color field estimation decouples shape and radiance by computing a color field directly from density and images, reducing NeRF ambiguity without geometric priors.
